text.description_html:
Don-Jo 90 CW Blank Wrap Around Door Security Plate

The 90-CW Wrap Around 12" x 5" Door Plate is for 1-3/4" thick doors. This Blank Stainless Steel Wrap Around Plate is most often used to cover an existing bore-holes. It can also be used to increase security at your home or office by protecting your doors from entry tools and tampering.

Features and Specifications of the Wrap Around 12" x 5" Plate Without Cut-Outs:

  • Material: 22 (.032 gauge) stainless steel construction
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Plate Length: 12"
  • Plate Width: 5"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4"
  • Heavy duty stainless steel trim screws
  • Permanent holding power eliminates loosening of latch mounting screws
  • Don-Jo 90-S-CW Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

Sold Individually
